headline: Last session: Nifty faced pressure reaching oversold levels; market closed today as Tata Trusts disputes leadership reappointment

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: The market is closed today for the weekend.
Tata Trusts has challenged the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons Chairman.
Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and rising crude oil prices are weighing on sentiment.
Technical indicators suggest Nifty is in oversold territory, eyeing a potential pullback.
whatHappening: Tata Trusts declared the Tata Sons Board's reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as 'void ab initio'.
Ashiana Housing plans to spend Rs 1,000 crore on land acquisition during the current fiscal year.
NSE shareholders maintained their holdings despite the recent Offer for Sale process.
New regulations will restrict LPG refills for non-eKYC households starting October 1.
summary: The Indian market is closed for the weekend, with focus on the escalating leadership dispute at Tata Sons. Ashiana Housing announced a significant Rs 1,000 crore investment for land acquisition. Traders are eyeing a potential Nifty pullback from oversold levels when markets reopen on Tuesday.
